title: Notifications
subtitle: What the system needed to tell someone
warranty_none: Nothing new: no warranties ending within {{n}} days that have not been flagged.
warranty_raised: Alert raised for {{n}} warranties nearing expiry.
escalation_disabled: Escalation is off. Set the escalation threshold in the collection reminders screen first.
escalation_none: Nothing new: every overdue item past the threshold was already escalated.
escalated_partial: Escalated {{n}} overdue items; {{remaining}} still waiting and will follow.
in_app_only: ⚠️ Notifications stay inside the platform: no email and no text messages. Anyone who does not open the app receives nothing.
